profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished Lead Software Engineer with a B.S. in Computer Science and over nine years of expertise in developing high-quality, robust software solutions. Specialized in designing and implementing efficient ETL tooling and infrastructure and solving productivity issues through automation. Committed to delivering innovative solutions and continuously improving processes to exceed project requirements. Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and attention to detail make me a valuable asset to any software development team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated on Inventory, an internal platform and self-service portal that automated GitHub Enterprise management using Python, MongoDB, Beanie ODM, Pydantic, Litestar, React, and the GitHub REST/GraphQL API, unifying the company's GitHub usage patterns and significantly enhancing security.

Engineered and implemented the Active Directory (AD) Credentials Provider (ADCP), a secure AD service account management solution with Jenkins, Groovy, and HashiCorp Vault, establishing safe, secure, and consistent service account usage patterns across the company.

Developed various automation solutions utilizing Jenkins pipelines and Groovy/Python scripts, significantly enhancing workflow efficiency and reducing manual work.

Conducted thorough code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices, enhancing code quality, and facilitating knowledge sharing within the development team.

Provided operational support, handling ServiceNow request and incident queues to ensure timely issue resolution and support.

Effectively handled on-call rotations, providing timely and effective resolution to critical system issues, minimizing downtime and ensuring business continuity.

Administered and maintained critical services including Vault, Jenkins, Sonatype Nexus, GitHub, and Datadog, ensuring their high availability, performance, and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · Jenkins · Software Configuration Management · Python · Groovy · Bash · Docker · Kubernetes · MongoDB · Continuous Integration · Back-End Web Development · Automated Software Testing · Linux · Linux System Administration · Unit Testing · Git · REST APIs · HashiCorp Vault

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Single-handedly designed, developed, and maintained all software systems and applications for SFL.

Designed and developed Conduit, a flexible data pipeline tool which automated the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of various data sets, resulting in significant efficiency gains and improved data quality and consistency.

Built efficient data pipelines to ensure data integrity and availability for downstream analysis and reporting.

Deployed and utilized Splunk to analyze data and produce customized dashboards that provided actionable, data-driven insights into software development processes to increase efficiency and improve software quality for multiple defense industry programs.

Designed and implemented a robust Jira architecture for a defense program with the goals of enabling efficient project management, efficient collaboration across multiple teams, and timely delivery of project milestones.

Produced and delivered performance metrics for software development teams to identify areas for improvement and increase team productivity.

Demonstrated exceptional problem-solving skills and an ability to adapt in a fast-paced startup environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the development of a software tool to effectively instrument and report on the software factory which streamlined software development processes.

Developed an embedded intrusion detection system (IDS) prototype for space vehicles to protect against cyber-attacks.

Modernized development and infrastructure for the cyber security division using proper Git workflow practices and automation using Puppet.

Integrated various commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) tools to develop a cyber security toolkit for a deployed Air Force weapons system hosted in DISA MilCloud intended for protecting both ground and space segments from cyber threats.

Developed an automated system to inject anomalies into space vehicle data to assist neural network training for cyber security tool development.

Designed and built a Splunk infrastructure with scaling and redundancy using tiered indexers and search heads to enable efficient queries on distributed data sets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Successfully oversaw the technical aspects of government and commercial contract proposals, ensuring compliance with requirements and industry standards.

Collaborated with NASA on Unmanned Aerial System Traffic Management (UTM) project by developing a prototype full-stack application with the goal of allowing manned and unmanned aerial vehicles to safely share airspace.

Optimized and enhanced legacy embedded system powering a self-stabilizing platform to add new features and account for updates in physical design requested by the customer.

Designed and developed Android application for robotic systems using GPS waypoints to automate agricultural processes.

Authored the technical portions of a user manual for a cutting-edge robot product, including detailed descriptions of product features, specifications, and operation instructions.

projects.title: CalamityEPGP
projects.description:
An addon for World of Warcraft (WoW) Classic to manage a guild's EPGP loot system. Includes features to help awarding effort points (EP) and gear points (GP) automatically and manually, distribute loot, display standings, and display event history for auditing. Data is synced between players in a peer-to-peer (P2P) fashion.

https://github.com/Frechetta/CalamityEPGP

projects.title: Conduit
projects.description:
- Built a flexible ETL tool written in Python to enhance OpenPIVT capabilities.
- Designed to be completely data-agnostic due to plugin support, allowing extreme flexibility.
- Deployable as a containerized or non-containerized server application for convenience.
- Implemented data pipelines as “workflows,” composed of tasks, enabling complex ETL operations.
- Developed a custom scheduler allowing for workflows to be executed in parallel on a schedule.
